R3_3.rating_invariance_permutation.statistic: between-specification SD of item-centred letter rating
R3_3.rating_invariance_permutation.note: Null permutes specification-condition assignments across observations (rating-invariance null), not accuracy labels. eta^2 is on specification-level aggregates of the item-centred rating and is not comparable to the individual-rating variance partition in Table 1.

R3_5.tau_calibration.construction: score = SIS on 16 calibration specs; flag = any IG/HY flip on the disjoint 16 validation specs (45 issuers)
R3_5.tau_calibration.note: tau chosen to maximise Youden's J on the held-out split; practitioners raise tau for higher precision, lower for higher recall.
